## Description

**Quantum Response Bodies** is a theoretical and computational research package for studying collective electromagnetic responses generated by correlated quantum-emitter arrays under fixed local marginals.

The local density matrix of every emitter is held fixed while global correlations and entanglement are allowed to vary. This removes response changes attributable to different local populations or local coherences and isolates correlation-dependent collective behavior.

The archive implements fixed-marginal quantum and separable response bodies, an exact three-emitter scaled-elliptope / signed-polar geometry, a three-setting calibrated photon-flux reconstruction with an exact separable-compatibility criterion, an inverse minimum-entanglement resource formulation, and microscopic free-space Green-tensor open-system benchmarks. It includes deterministic regression tests, machine-readable numerical summaries, multistart noisy-support calculations, and figure-generation scripts supporting the accompanying manuscript *Fixed-Marginal Response Geometry for Quantum-Emitter Arrays*.

The exact ideal-body results are analytic within the stated model. The noisy separable support uses an exact convex-dual reduction followed by reproducible multistart nonconvex product-numerical-range optimization and is not presented as a formal global certificate at all continuous times.
